criteria.requirement: Explain strip in parse, CRLF normalization, strip in format, and the fact that the default YAML path converts input to ordinary values and does not preserve comments or quotes on export.

Changing only the export Dumper cannot restore original whitespace and comments that have already been lost. A custom handler does not provide complete lossless editing out of the box. Distinguish semantic values from original bytes.

Compare caller-side preservation of the original text with restricted editing against extensions such as an explicit preservation mode or round-trip nodes. Explain added dependencies or limitations, refusal to modify on failure, and compatibility with default behavior. Accept multiple reasonable choices.

Recommend a feasible minimal scope and a way to verify title-only changes. Explain unsupported or uncommitted boundaries such as unknown syntax, block scalars, anchors, and duplicate keys. Do not require a particular third-party library or write the implementation.

comparison: Evaluate facts, behavior, and constraints rather than keywords, answer length, or similarity to a reference answer.
